data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 were GBP 627.639m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse movement on prior years of approximately GBP 33.5m (primarily from the 2019 underwriting year), indicating a gross strengthening of reserves of ~5.3% of opening reserves. This result sits alongside a reported net favourable prior year development of GBP 2.3m (net of reinsurance), reflecting significant reinsurance recoveries and reallocation effects (including an RITC transfer noted elsewhere). Catastrophe activity in 2021 (notably Hurricane Ida and European floods) and movements in large loss and attritional experience influenced overall claims development.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development: gross figure derived from the gross claims development triangle (2019 column) - triangle limited to 2019-2021. Narrative reports a net favourable prior year development (GBP 2.3m) which differs from the gross triangle-based adverse movement (+GBP 33.463m), indicating significant reinsurance effects and the impact of an RITC transfer (RITC to Syndicate 3500) during the year which distorts aggregate movements. Lob_movements are taken from the reported prior year development by line of business but are net of reinsurance (document provides net amounts in that table) - gross by-LOB movements are not provided. Users should note the possible distortion from the RITC and the mix of gross vs net figures where indicated.
